business_scope.primary_industry_name: Statutory Company Secretarial and Commercial Registered Agent Office

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (including Overseas Departments and Collectivities for RNE registration purposes; metropolitan seat recommended)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law - Unitary National System, with specialized commercial courts (Tribunaux de Commerce) and a codified Commercial Code governing company registration and RNE (Registre National des Entreprises)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Articles 49-54 (Freedom of Establishment)
France-China Bilateral Investment Agreement (signed 1984, in force 1986)
France-United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (1966, as amended; Article 24 non-discrimination; no comprehensive US-France BIT)
Energy Charter Treaty (ratified by France, in force)
OECD Multilateral Instrument (MLI) implemented through Ordinance n°2020-1836 for DTAAs
More than 100 additional BITs and 135+ income tax treaties in force as administered by the French Treasury (DG Trésor)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L.561-1 to L.561-59 and R.561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT obligations transposing EU Directive 2015/849 as amended by Directive 2018/843); UBO register obligations: CMF Articles L.561-45 to L.561-49 and Décret n°2016-1031 du 9 août 2016, with implementing Articles R.561-52 et seq.; sanctions and asset-freezing: CMF Articles L.562-1 to L.562-19 and EU Council Regulation (EC) No 269/2014; corporate registration and RNE/RCS declaration: Code de commerce Articles L.123-5, L.123-25, R.123-40 and R.123-53.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each UBO's passport with notarized signature attestation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the UBO's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Hague Convention of 5 October 1961; apostille by the competent ministry of the originating state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Register of Directors and Register of Members of any intermediate or ultimate corporate shareholder (exhaustive corporate-ladder piercing up to the final natural person)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, supplemented by certified French translation by an oath-bound translator (traducteur assermenté)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential and trading address of each UBO (utility bill or bank statement issued within the immediately preceding 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or issuing bank of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the issuer's signature; bank documents must be countersigned by the bank's compliance officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming UBO's source of funds and basic KYC profile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Primary relationship bank of the UBO or of the ultimate parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and certified French translation; direct banker-to-banker confirmation letter recommended to Tracfin standards

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and ongoing screening of all UBOs, directors (gérants) and signatories against: (i) EU Council Regulation (EC) No 269/2014 restrictive measures list; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated List as transposed in France by acts of DG Trésor (Ministry of Economy); (iii) French national terrorist asset-freezing list under CMF Article L.562-2; and (iv) OFAC SDN List where any USD payment rail is engaged. Automatic PEP classification with full family and close-associate coverage is required under FATF and EU standards; false positives must be cleared by a documented manual review. Any confirmed match or suspicion triggers a Suspicious Transaction Report (Déclaration de Soupçon) to Tracfin under CMF Article L.561-15 within two business days. UBO register access by obliged entities is limited to authorities and to justified legitimate-interest requests for transactions of EUR 2,000 or above.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) with RNE data search via the INPI Data Board and prior availability verification against RCS historical databases via Infogreffe
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Act n°94-665 of 4 August 1994 (Loi Toubon) and Code de la consommation Article L.121-1, the SARL's bylaws, statutory declarations, and mandatory corporate instruments must be drafted in French. The corporate name (dénomination sociale) may include a foreign-language element only if that element constitutes a registered trademark or is accompanied by a French statutory translation. Non-Latin scripts (e.g., Arabic, Cyrillic, Chinese, Hebrew) must be transliterated into Latin characters for inscription at the RNE; a certified transliteration statement by an oath-bound translator must be filed with the registration dossier.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque, banquier, établissement de crédit (requires ACPR credit institution authorization)
Assurance, assureur, mutuelle, courtier, société de crédit (requires ACPR authorization)
France, République, français, national (misleading appropriation of public authority; specific authorization or legitimate governmental designation required)
Université, caisse, consulat, chambre de commerce (reserved for public bodies),
Certifié, agréé, autorisé, officiel (absent the underlying official accreditation)
Any token reproducing a protected trade name, trademark, or domain name of a third party causing likelihood of confusion within the RNE registrar's assessment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The French RNE does not operate a statutory name-reservation facility; name availability is verified through the Guichet Unique preliminary screening, and market practice treats the availability attestation as valid for 30 calendar days. If the chosen dénomination sociale is rejected by the INPI registrar, the applicant must (i) resubmit a corrected dossier via the Guichet Unique with an alternative name and a letter explaining the removed tokens; (ii) file a 'recours gracieux' with the INPI RNE Registrar within 30 days of the rejection notification, attaching the preliminary search and trademark clearance evidence; and (iii) if the administrative refusal is maintained, petition the President of the Tribunal de Commerce (or the President of the Tribunal Judiciaire in non-commercial first-instance competences) under Code de commerce Article L.123-5-2 and Décret n°67-237 Article 14 to obtain a judicial order compelling registration. Concurrent filing of the name as an INPI trademark is strongly advised to secure residual monitorable rights against conflicting later registrations.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this industry subject to Code de commerce Articles L.123-11-1 to L.123-11-4. A SARL may elect its registered office (siège social) at the premises of a professional domiciliation company, but the arrangement requires: (i) a written domiciliation contract with the provider; (ii) the provider's valid prior declaration with the Préfecture du département (the provider must hold actual operational premises in France, not a post-office box, and must maintain personnel present during working hours); (iii) a renewable initial term not exceeding five years, extendable up to ten years; and (iv) a genuine French operational address distinguishable from a mere letterbox. For corporate secretarial and registered-agent lines of business, the domiciliation provider itself must not be a prohibited or under-sanction entity, and the arrangement must be disclosed to the RNE with the provider's identity. Pure 'virtual-only' postbox arrangements without any human presence or business substance expose the SARL to commercial registry scrutiny and tax residence challenges.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 20-25% annualized likelihood of unannounced physical or documentary inspection for this compliance-sensitive sector. Triggers include: inconsistencies between the declared registered office and actual operations, red flags from Tracfin intelligence, tax administration sur place fiscal checks, and greffe verification procedures during RNE registration of changes. Inbound foreign-owned and offshore-oriented letterbox structures face materially higher inspection probability upon first-year administrative review.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of SARL Articles of Association (Statuts) by a French Avocat, including gérant appointment, capital clauses, UBO declarations, and RNE registration filing kit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed written fee at approximately EUR 2,200 (based on EUR 250-450/hour rate, 6-10 hours)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Capital deposit attestation (dépôt du capital social; Article L.223-7 Code de commerce) and bank certificate for SARL articles
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial bank or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark bank tariff for capital-blocking certificate issuance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of statutory incorporation notice (avis de constitution) in an authorized legal-announcement gazette (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales authorized for the seat's département
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by arrêté préfectoral; approximately EUR 190-280 depending on the département and notice length

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SARL registration fees at the Guichet Unique / RNE (INPI) and greffe of the competent Tribunal de Commerce, including controlled inspection and RCS extract
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI and Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff set by decree (tarif des greffiers and INPI RNE fee schedule), approximately EUR 55-60 plus ancillary charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs) filing alongside the incorporation dossier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulatory flat fee; no separate charge, included in the RNE registration tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: One-year contractual virtual registered office and commercial domiciliation package with a préfecture-declared provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: EUR 300-900 per year depending on location, premises class, and mail-forwarding services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized apostille bundle and certified French translations for UBO passports, corporate shareholder documentation, and address proofs (approximately 4-6 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traducteur assermenté) and Ministry of Justice apostille office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market tariff for sworn translation EUR 40-80/page plus fixed apostille and notary stamps; 3-translation-page benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT PEP and sanctions screening software platform (first-year subscription) for UBO, gérants, and counterparty coverage
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance software vendor (e.g., World-Check-equivalent, Dow Jones, or French AML data provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark subscription, EUR 600-1,400 per seat-year for medium-risk corporate service providers

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional indemnity insurance (RC Professionnelle) initial annual premium for corporate secretarial and registered-agent activities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for ISIC 8299 corporate-service risks with EUR 1M-2M coverage limit

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC procedures manual and French SARL governance pack adapted to the corporate-secretarial business line, including go-to-market checklists and Tracfin reporting templates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French Avocat or certified AML consultant
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for tailored compliance documentation under CMF Articles L.561-5 and L.561-13

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II — Articles L. 210-1 et seq. (general company provisions), L. 223-1 to L. 223-43 (SARL), L. 123-1 and R. 123-30 (Registre du commerce et des sociétés and extrait K-bis), and Articles L. 123-11-2 and R. 123-166 et seq. (regulated company domiciliation and registered-agent activity).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) maintained by the Greffe du tribunal de commerce of the registered-office jurisdiction, receiving filings through the Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), with automatic notification to INSEE, URSSAF and DGFiP.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'entreprise (electronic composite dossier) comprising the signed statuts, the certificate of escrowed funds (attestation de dépôt des fonds), the proof of legal-notice publication (justificatif de parution au journal d'annonces légales), and the registered-office occupancy consent, filed through the Guichet unique in replacement of the former CERFA n° 11682/M0 form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for SARL (Law no. 2003-721 of 1 August 2003 abolished the former minimum); capital is freely fixed in the statuts. Cash subscriptions must be deposited into a blocked escrow account (compte bloqué) opened in the name of the SARL in formation with a French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and released only upon RCS registration. At least one-fifth of cash contributions must be paid up on incorporation and the balance within five years; in-kind contributions are fully released upon incorporation and, if their value exceeds legal thresholds, must be appraised by a commissaire aux apports.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: Whereas the undersigned have subscribed to all shares of the SARL in formation under the draft statuts: 1. APPROVAL — the draft statuts and share subscriptions totaling EUR [•] are ratified; 2. REGISTERED OFFICE — the registered office is established at [address]; 3. APPOINTMENTS — [Name] is unanimously appointed gérant for an indefinite term; 4. AUTHORIZATIONS — the gérant is authorized to deposit subscription funds in a blocked account, publish the statutory notice, and complete all formalities before the Guichet unique, the Trade and Companies Registry, the Préfecture, and tax authorities; 5. ACTIVATION — the gérant shall open bank accounts and commence the registered-agent and corporate secretarial business upon issuance of the K-bis.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow the share capital and obtain the blocked-funds certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution (bank) or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a dedicated non-operational blocked account in the name of the SARL in formation with a licensed French bank or the CDC; transfer the subscribed cash share capital; request the certificate of blocked funds (attestation de dépôt des fonds) naming the proposed corporate name, the bank, and the exact capital amount. The funds remain blocked and are released only upon presentation of the RCS registration certificate (extrait K-bis).
required_dossiers: Identity documents and KYC/AML questionnaires of all partners (ultimate beneficial owners)
Proof of address of each partner
Business purpose description (ISIC 8299 — registered-agent and company secretarial services) and source-of-funds statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank applies enhanced KYC or declines the relationship, submit a source-of-funds declaration and an updated UBO structure to the bank's central compliance desk; if still refused, open the escrow account with another licensed credit institution or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and re-obtain the attestation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French entities register with DGFiP to obtain SIREN number and VAT identification number (FR followed by 11 digits). Foreign entities must establish a permanent establishment or subsidiary and submit incorporation documents, articles of association, and tax forms through guichet unique or directly to DGFiP.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; hybrid mismatch rules apply under EU directives without elective classification mechanisms.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing under French e-Facture system with digital stamping, API integration for B2B transactions, and fiscal clearance requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for exports of goods and services to non-EU countries upon proof of export and non-EU destination
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims result in fines up to 80% of evaded VAT, criminal penalties, and retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT with interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) in coordination with the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) and the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) for banking supervision and foreign exchange policy.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a Eurozone member; the euro is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions. There are no exchange controls on capital movements within the EU and generally free movement of capital with non-EU countries, subject to EU sanctions and anti-money laundering (AML) reporting. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is unrestricted, but must comply with corporate tax withholding (if applicable) and transfer pricing documentation. No prior authorization is required for dividend distributions, but the company must file annual tax returns and report cross-border payments to the French tax authorities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender of export proceeds to the central bank or any conversion requirement. Exporters may retain foreign currency in authorized accounts, but must report all cross-border transactions to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistics (via the 'Réglementation des changes' reporting). The reporting threshold is €12,500 per transaction or cumulative monthly reporting for larger flows. No statutory timeline for conversion; however, companies must maintain proper documentation for tax and customs purposes.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. French-regulated EMIs (e.g., Qonto, Shine, N26 Business) offer streamlined onboarding and multi-currency accounts, but may have lower transaction limits and less robust trade finance capabilities. Cross-border EMIs from other EU states can passport into France under the PSD2 regime, but they must register with the ACPR. For a registered agent/offshore secretarial business, EMIs are viable for operational liquidity and low-volume cross-border payments, but for high-value trade settlements and LC operations, a full-service commercial bank is recommended. Legal constraints: EMIs cannot provide credit or hold client funds for investment; they are limited to payment services.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally required for the legal representative (gérant) and any beneficial owners (UBOs) during initial onboarding at tier-1 banks. Remote opening is possible via video identification (e.g., using ACPR-approved e-KYC solutions) for certain banks, but the bank's compliance team may still request an in-person interview for medium-risk businesses. For a registered agent/offshore secretarial entity, a physical visit to the registered office is often mandatory to verify operational substance. The KYC interview must cover the business model, source of funds, and expected transaction volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction exposure (e.g., clients from offshore financial centers)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a detailed client acceptance policy, enhanced due diligence (EDD) procedures, and a list of sanctioned jurisdictions. Include proof of compliance with French AML law (Code Monétaire et Financier) and FATF recommendations. Submit a business continuity plan and a description of the company's own AML/CFT controls.

Provide a full organizational chart with UBOs (individuals holding >25% shares or control), copies of passports, proof of address, and a declaration of the ultimate beneficial owner. Include the French 'Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs' (RBE) filing confirmation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction patterns (e.g., high volume of cross-border wires with low substance)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a detailed business plan, client contracts, and a forecast of transaction volumes. Include a description of the company's role as a registered agent, with evidence of actual office space, staff, and operational expenses. Provide a list of clients and their business purposes, along with any relevant licenses (e.g., registered agent license).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential tax evasion or money laundering via offshore structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a tax compliance certificate from the French tax authorities, proof of filing of corporate tax returns, and a copy of the company's tax risk assessment. Include a letter from an external auditor confirming the company's adherence to transfer pricing rules and the absence of aggressive tax planning.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocols: Inbound capital injections (e.g., share capital increase or shareholder loans) must be routed via SWIFT MT103 with a clear purpose code. For capital contributions, use the French balance-of-payments code '12' (Direct Investment) or '10' (Capital Operations). The bank will require a copy of the shareholders' resolution, a notarized deed of increase, and proof of the source of funds. For shareholder loans, use code '11' (Loans) and provide a loan agreement. All transfers must be accompanied by a 'Déclaration de Transfert de Fonds' (DTF) if the amount exceeds €10,000. The receiving bank will verify the purpose and may request additional documentation to comply with AML regulations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements: For payments to suppliers or service providers, use SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers. For documentary trade, use Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) via SWIFT MT700/MT707, with the bank acting as issuing or advising bank. For high-value transactions, consider using the TARGET2 system for euro-denominated payments. For non-euro currencies, use correspondent banking networks. All outbound payments must include a valid purpose code (e.g., '130' for services) and comply with the French foreign trade regulations. The bank may require supporting invoices and contracts for amounts above €12,500.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward contracts (FX Forwards) for EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, and other major pairs, with a maximum tenor of 12 months for non-speculative hedging.
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for exotic currencies (e.g., emerging market currencies) where deliverable forwards are not available, subject to ACPR approval and underlying exposure verification.
Currency swaps (FX Swaps) for managing short-term liquidity and rolling over positions, provided they are used for hedging actual commercial exposure.
Options (FX Options) for hedging contingent exposures, but only with a clear risk management policy and board approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts filing (dépôt des comptes annuels) at the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce de Paris / competent commercial court registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of shareholder approval of the financial year, and in all cases within six months of the fiscal year-end (standard filing date 30 April)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed fine of €150 per delayed filing, up to €2,000, plus administrative strike-off procedure initiated after a 15-day notice from the registry if accounts remain unfiled

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale – déclaration de résultats)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the second business day after 1 May of the tax year (typically 3 May; for online filers applicable calendar extensions do not apply)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-filing penalty, increased to 40% if the return is not filed within 30 days of a formal notice, plus monthly interest at 0.40% on outstanding corporate tax

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner declaration update (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / INPI national register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days of any substantial change to shareholding or indirect ownership; no recurring calendar-year filing requirement exists
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to €1,000 per omitted declaration, and potential criminal liability for directors in cases of intentional non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business property tax declaration and payment (cotisation foncière des entreprises – CFE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Centre des Finances Publiques / local municipal tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due 15 December of the tax year; no separate annual return is required for entities continuously registered before 1 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalty of 10%, plus monthly interest at 0.10%; enforced collection proceedings and loss of tax payment history if not settled

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) for an SARL if at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded at the balance-sheet date: total assets €4,000,000, net turnover €8,000,000, or average workforce exceeding 50 employees
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) with the option to adopt IFRS for consolidated financial statements; all statutory accounts must be prepared in euros and in French

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no separate annual UBO confirmation filing in France; beneficial-owner data must be kept up to date at the Trade Registry through a new declaration filed within 60 days of any shareholding or control change
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des procès-verbaux de l'assemblée (Minute Book)
Registre des mouvements de titres (Share Transfer Register)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $3,200–$8,700 (typical €3,000–€8,000 range for a statutory audit engagement)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate; reduced 15% applies to the first €42,433 of taxable profit for eligible small enterprises under Article 219 CGI)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Patent box regime effective 10% on net qualifying patent/licence income; Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% of eligible R&D expenses up to €100M; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% capped; reduced 15% CIT rate for eligible SMEs on first €42,433.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (statutory carryforward is indefinite but annual deductible amount is capped at €1M plus 50% of taxable income exceeding €1M)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: French corporate income tax return: No. 2065-SD (liasse fiscale) and annexes 2050 to 2059-SD, filed electronically through Impots.gouv.fr (EFI / EDI) or the EMZA portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; with quarterly corporate income tax instalments due 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December for calendar-year taxpayers.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, return due by the second working day following 1 May of the next year; for a fiscal year closing on any other date, return due within three months of the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, RCS registration number, SIREN, form (SARL), head office, registered office, tax ID and fiscal year dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident corporate shareholder, identify the French branch or PE if any; if no PE, no corporate tax return is filed, and only direct withholding declarations for French-source income may apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting income adjusted for non-deductible expenses, depreciation, provisions, capital gains and losses, and carried-forward deficits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only report income and deductions physically or economically allocable to the French permanent establishment; respect the applicable DTA and exclude foreign-source items unless the anti-abuse and CFC rules apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current-year tax loss carryback/carryforward positions and imputation history.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the French statutory annual cap: €1M plus 50% of taxable profit above €1M; losses from a non-PE foreign source cannot be reported.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: 2058-SD – Détermination du résultat et répartition du capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allocation of taxable income among beneficiaries and capital distribution, including withholding taxes on non-resident distributions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the percentage held by each non-resident shareholder and attach the definitive list of beneficial owners where distributions or DTA relief are claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: 2059-A-SD – Suivi des intérêts, redevances et charges financières
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Schedule of interest, royalties and other cross-border payments with the related transfer-pricing justification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For cross-border payments to affiliated non-residents, maintain contemporaneous documentation demonstrating arm's-length benefit and actual economic substance; reduced withholding or DTA credits are claimed on this schedule.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% penalty (10% if not filed within 30 days of formal notice), plus 0.20% monthly interest on tax due; deliberate concealment raises the penalty to 40% or 80%; criminal sanctions under Art. 1741 CGI up to €500,000 fine and 5 years' imprisonment for tax evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% domestic withholding on dividends paid to non-resident corporate shareholders (Art. 119 bis(2) CGI); 30% for non-resident individuals (12.8% PFU plus 17.2% social levies); reduced or eliminated under tax treaties and the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before payment, the non-resident shareholder must provide a valid tax residence certificate (TRC) from its tax authority. France applies treaty relief at source when the recipient submits the foreign certificate plus the administrative form corresponding to the DTA (e.g., Form 5000). For EU/EEA corporate shareholders holding at least 5% for two years, the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive can provide full withholding exemption. If withholding is imposed incorrectly or excess tax is prelevied, a refund claim must be filed with the French Non-Resident Tax Office within three years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to non-residents: statutory domestic withholding 33⅓% (Art. 182 B CGI), typically reduced under DTA to 0%, 5% or 10% for patents, know-how, and copyrights. Interest paid to non-residents: no domestic withholding on arm's-length conventional interest, except for profit-participating loans or payments to non-cooperative jurisdictions which may be subject to 30% or 75%; most French DTAs reserve interest taxation to the residence state of the beneficiary.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: French Local File and Master File are mandatory where the French entity has annual turnover or gross assets ≥ €400 million or belongs to a multinational group exceeding €750 million consolidated revenue for Country-by-Country reporting; smaller companies must nevertheless keep contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation to prove arm's-length transactions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not apply offshore Economic Substance Regulations, but implements an abuse-of-law rule (Art. L.64 LPF) and CFC legislation (Art. 209 B CGI). A French SARL with no real office, employees, meetings, or independent management decision-making is disregarded as a letterbox, and its income is reattributed to the economic owners. Registered-agent-only structures are therefore subject to active anti-shell-company attack.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting French-source revenue from secretarial/registered-agent fees, issuing fictitious invoices, failing to file corporate income tax returns, or maintaining undisclosed bank accounts and cash-flow rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalty under Art. 1741 CGI: fine up to €500,000 and 5 years' imprisonment; increased to €1,000,000 and 7 years where committed by an organised gang; administrative penalty of 40% or 80% for deliberate concealment, plus monthly interest of 0.20%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors (gérants) are personally and jointly liable under Art. L. 267 LPF for corporate taxes, penalties and interest where their deliberate mismanagement enabled evasion; travel bans, freezing of personal assets, and extradition are possible for non-resident officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Sham Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the French SARL only as a letterbox or passive invoice platform, with no genuine office, employees, business discretion, or operational risk, and relying on an offshore registered agent to perform all real activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The French tax administration applies the abuse-of-law doctrine (Art. L.64 LPF) to disregard the SARL, reattributing its income to the foreign parent; the company loses input VAT deductions, incurs 80% penalty for concealment, and may face automatic dissolution for statutory non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are civilly liable for the resulting tax adjustments; can be prohibited from managing a French company for up to 10 years; non-resident directors may be refused entry to France and have their vehicles or real estate seized under fiscal enforcement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Providing registered-agent and company secretarial services without conducting adequate KYC/UBO verification, failing to file the beneficial ownership declaration (RBE), or using nominees/offshore structures to conceal the actual shareholder of the SARL.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ACPR/AMF sanctions up to €5 million or 10% of annual turnover for serious AML/CTF failures; criminal money-laundering penalties under Art. 324-1 Penal Code: up to 5 years' imprisonment and €375,000 fine (aggravated form: 10 years and €750,000); the registered-agent licence may be revoked and the entity dissolved.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors have criminal liability for knowingly organizing money-laundering or circumventing Tracfin suspicious transaction reports; individual fines, confiscation of professional property, and professional interdiction are enforced on their personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Billing related-party services (management fees, secretarial fees, intellectual property charges) at non-arm's-length prices, relying on invoices without written agreements, or failing to supply the French tax administration with transfer-pricing documentation within 30 days of demand.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax reassessment plus 5% transfer-pricing penalty on the recharacterised amount and 0.20% monthly interest; payments to non-cooperative jurisdictions are disallowed under Art. 238 A; criminal exposure arises where false documents are fabricated to support artificial pricing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The gérant who intentionally arranged undervalued or inflated intercompany flows is personally liable for the resulting tax credits and penalties; directors may be disqualified from corporate management and their personal bank accounts sealed during the fiscal enforcement procedure.
